svg.title: Deduction versus credit: how much R1 000 saves you
svg.desc: A R1 000 deduction, such as a retirement annuity contribution, lowers taxable income, so for someone whose top bracket is 31% it saves R310. A R1 000 tax credit, such as the medical scheme fees credit, comes straight off the tax bill, so it saves the full R1 000.
svg.text: Deduction vs credit: what R1 000 saves you
Example: someone whose top tax bracket is 31%.
lowers your taxable income, so saves your top rate: 31% × R1 000
R1 000 tax credit (e.g. medical scheme fees credit)
comes straight off your tax bill, rand for rand
Limits apply to both; see the course's facts and figures. Not tax advice.
